people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”
translations.bsb: And while they were reclining and eating, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, one of you who is eating with Me will betray Me.”
translations.kjv: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
translations.asv: And as they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you shall betray me, even he that eateth with me.
